name: Panthera C2 (Trinocular)
summary: Upright biological microscope with Motic's Colour Corrected Infinity Optical System (CCIS) and plan achromatic objectives from 4x to 100x. The trinocular head adds a camera port for digital imaging, with Köhler LED illumination and a USB port to power an external camera.

specs.label: Objectives
specs.value: Plan UC achromatic, infinity corrected: 4x, 10x, 40x S, 100x S-Oil

specs.label: Eyepieces
specs.value: Widefield UC-WF10x/22 mm, diopter adjustment, high eyepoint

specs.label: Camera
specs.value: Integral USB 2.0 port to power an external camera; C-mount adapter sold separately

specs.label: Stage
specs.value: Rackless mechanical stage with dual slide holder, 185 × 145 mm

specs.label: Focus
specs.value: Coaxial coarse/fine, 25 mm range, 2 µm minimum increment, adjustable tension

specs.label: Condenser
specs.value: Köhler-type Abbe condenser, N.A. 0.90/1.25, with slider slot

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: 3 W LED, switchable 3500 K / 5500 K (30 W halogen option)

specs.label: Light control
specs.value: Light intensity memory per objective, sleep mode, nosepiece intensity indicator

specs.label: Contrast options
specs.value: Brightfield; phase contrast, darkfield, polarization and fluorescence as add-ons

features: Plan achromatic objectives from 4x to 100x oil
Trinocular head with camera port for digital documentation
USB port to power an external camera
Full Köhler illumination with 3 W LED
Rackless stage with dual slide holder
Upgradeable to phase contrast, darkfield, polarization and fluorescence
